commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+9' The attendance is 21732.
90+7' Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul after Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) hacks down one of his opponents. Union Berlin are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+5' 43:57 – the latest ball possession ratio.
90+4' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
90+1' Oliver Baumann blocks a long-range effort from Alex Kral (Union Berlin) towards the bottom left corner.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
89' Hoffenheim enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
86' The resulting corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
86' Here is a change. Tim Lemperle is going off and Christian Ilzer gives the last tactical orders to Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim).
86' Here comes a substitution. Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Robert Skov.
85' The linesman makes the right call and Union Berlin will have a corner.
83' 2 - 4 Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Frederik Ronnow to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
82' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) is going to take the penalty!
82' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) receives a red card due to his mindless behaviour. His team will now have to play with a man down.
82' PENALTY AWARDED to Hoffenheim!
81' A player from Union Berlin commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Bazoumana Toure walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
77' Albian Hajdari is substituted due to injury. Christian Ilzer gives a chance to Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim).
77' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
74' Here's the change. Oliver Burke leaves the pitch and Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
74' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) replacing Ilyas Ansah.
74' The game has come to an end for Rani Khedira. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin).
71' The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.
71' 2 - 3 Goal! Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 2:3.
70' A pass finds the feet of Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
69' A pass by Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Janik Haberer as he is replaced by Alex Kral (Union Berlin).
66' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Fisnik Asllani will be replaced by Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).
66' Substitution. Andrej Kramaric walks off the pitch and Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
65' A corner kick by Union Berlin is thwarted by the well prepared Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim).
64' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Union Berlin.
64' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner.
61' 10:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
59' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

58' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Frederik Ronnow.
57' Booking. Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) receives a caution from the referee.
55' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out.
54' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is penalised for holding. Tobias Welz signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Hoffenheim, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
53' Handball by Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin).
51' 1 - 3 Goal! The rebound fell to Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:3.
49' 1 - 2 GOAL! Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) scores easily from close in after he is presented with the ball on a golden platter after the goalkeeper slips. It’s 1:2.
49' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
47' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' 0 - 2 Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) scores from a quite difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the left post. Excellent finish.
45+1' 0 - 1 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Frederik Ronnow to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
45+1' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

41' Corner kick. Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is ready to send the ball into the box.
40' 1:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
37' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
35' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
32' Hoffenheim hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

28' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Free kick. Union Berlin will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
28' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
26' Tobias Welz blows his whistle. Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) commits a foul after dangerous play. Union Berlin will take a free kick.
24' 38:62 – the ratio of ball possession.

23' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
21' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.
20' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) unleashes a shot from distance but his effort is well blocked.
19' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
18' The corner from Christopher Trimmel is intercepted by Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim).
18' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Union Berlin get a corner.
15' Hoffenheim control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

12' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Oliver Burke (Union Berlin), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
10' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
8' PENALTY APPEAL after Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
8' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

7' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee points to the corner flag and Union Berlin will take a corner.
6' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
5' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
4' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) makes a strong challenge and Tobias Welz blows for a foul.
4' Union Berlin keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Hoffenheim will kick-off.
Tobias Welz got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
